newsitem.title: CANADA: Sask Wheat Pool buys Alberta feed mill.
newsitem.headline: Sask Wheat Pool buys Alberta feed mill.

text.p: Canada's largest grain handler on Wednesday said it purchased an Alberta feed mill to be operated by Saskatchewan Wheat Pool from July 1 onward, SWP's chief executive said.
"It's the first feed mill we've purchased in Alberta," SWP chief executive Don Loewen told Reuters.
Loewen declined to disclose the purchase price or indicate whether SWP planned to buy any other Prairie feed mills.
SWP bought another feed mill in Manitoba earlier in 1997.
The Picture Butte, Alberta, facility has an annual handling capacity of 65,000 to 70,000 tonnes, Loewen said.
The mill supplies feed for hogs and other livestock.
